name: 布克棱岩
evolution: 布是石 → 布是岩 Lv.16 → 布克棱岩 Lv.32 → 迷嶂布莱克
evolutionEn: Bushishi → Bushiyan Lv.16 → Bukelengyan Lv.32 → Mizhangbulaike
description: 颇具威慑力的精灵，身形巨大，不经常远离驻地。看上去很重，但其实身体的主要重量都集中在头和手上的岩石部分。
descriptionEn: A rather intimidating spirit, huge in build, it does not often stray far from its dwelling. It looks very heavy, but in fact most of its body weight is concentrated in the rocky parts of its head and hands.

skills.name: 跺地
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks.

skills.name: 岩脉崩毁
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能能耗固定为4。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; this skill's energy cost is fixed at 4.

skills.name: 硬化
skills.description: 减伤90%，若上次使用攻击技则本技能能耗-2，应对攻击。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 90%; if an attack skill was used last time, this skill's energy cost -2; counters attacks.

skills.name: 石锁
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得3回合禁足。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy is immobilized for 3 turns.

skills.name: 蓄势待发
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains 1 stack of Charge Up mark.

skills.name: 吨位压制
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方体重越低，威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the lower the enemy's weight, the higher the power.

skills.name: 壁垒
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：防御技能冷却-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 90%; counters attacks: defense skill cooldown -1.

skills.name: 砂石冲撞
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，自己获得物防+100%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, self gains +100% physical defense.

skills.name: 岩土暴击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每被攻击1次。本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each time it is attacked once, this skill's energy cost is permanently -1.

skills.name: 地震
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 沙涌
skills.description: 将天气改为沙暴，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Changes the weather to sandstorm for 8 turns.

skills.name: 地刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; against Status: additionally interrupts the countered skill.

skills.name: 不动如山
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：自己获得物攻+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 90%; counters attacks: self gains +50% physical attack.
